about: Expected critic results for the calibration drafts. Never shown to the critic. Limits are truth/brand/helping verdicts. Rank pairs anchor "good" to the best hooks we have (round 2, 2026-11-17, which the founder judged better than the first test), never to an older, weaker batch; when a better batch exists, its lines replace the top of these pairs.

c07.line: Your aces lost to five-two offsuit, and that proves nothing.

c11.line: If you've never lost an all-in with pocket aces, you haven't had enough of them.

c12.line: 'My flush draws never hit.' From the flop, seeing both cards, they hit 1 in 3.

c06.line: Would you chase a 16% shot? That's a flop gutshot by the river. 'Never chase gutshots' is half right, and the other half matters.

c14.why: struck by the founder for craft, true
c14.line: Only 1 in 39 hands, on average, is pocket aces, kings, queens or ace-king. Folding the rest isn't discipline. It's a bill.

c16.line: You got pocket aces all in before the flop, and lost to five-two offsuit. That wasn't the app being rigged. It was supposed to happen.

c21.line: You fold your flush draw to a big bet and the heart comes on the river. Most players call that fold a mistake. Most of the time it's the right one.

c24.why: folding costs only in the blinds
c24.line: The nit at your table isn't losing slowly because he's unlucky. He's paying for every hand he folds.
